CR-001.title: Add different analysis sections (Discovery, Onboarding, CSM)
CR-001.description: Segment sections and analysis by meeting type. This will provide a clearer view of performance during certain meetings. This will also allow segmentation between sales reps, project management and CSM/Managing Directors.
CR-001.business_justification: Provides clear segmentation of analysis and allows for functionality and scoring to be sold separately or collectively.
CR-001.verification: Sales section shows only discovery + follow_up. CSM shows onboarding + check_in. Internal excluded from both.

CR-002.title: Summarized Strengths & Areas for Improvement on Rep homepage
CR-002.description: To avoid information overload and ensure that the rep has actionable insights, summarize the coaching insights section recommendation into 5 core strengths and 5 core areas for improvement. If the rep wants to drill down into all insights, that should still be allowed.
CR-002.business_justification: User adoption on the platform. There is a lot of information being generated at current. If this is not reduced it will likely result in information overload and a lack of user adoption.
CR-002.verification: Rep page shows concise top 5 strengths + 5 improvements above coaching detail. Drill-down shows full insights.

CR-003.title: Ability to change the date range on the rep dashboard
CR-003.description: Allow users to adjust the date range on the rep dashboard. This will allow for a more granular level of comparison, as well as introduce the option of comparison periods.
CR-003.business_justification: The rep dashboard is currently set to a static date range. Allowing for date range adjustments provides more functionality for users to review improvements over time.
CR-003.verification: Rep KPIs and meeting list filter by selected date range.

CR-004.title: Remove internal meetings from the analysis and scorecard
CR-004.description: To ensure the privacy of internal conversations, the scoring and analysis should completely exclude internal conversations.
CR-004.business_justification: Privacy and compliance adherence to avoid any negative exposure that could result from capturing and analysis internal meetings.
CR-004.verification: Scorecard KPIs exclude internal meetings. Feed hides internal by default. Company and rep pages exclude internal from aggregations. Internal filter still works when explicitly selected.

CR-005.title: Score reason summaries
CR-005.description: Alongside the scores, provide a score reason summary to give more context into the scoring.
CR-005.business_justification: Provides validation of the scores and will allow the team to identify any gaps within the scores moving forward.
CR-005.verification: Each stage type shows relevant reason text below its score gauges.

CR-006.title: Watch Recording opens Zoom Link or plays in the platform
CR-006.description: To avoid having to download every video a users wants to watch, adding functionality into the platform to either watch the video in platform or through Zoom would be a better user experience.
CR-006.business_justification: Provides a better user experience for users and increases ease of use.
CR-006.verification: User can watch recording without downloading. Recording opens in Zoom or plays in-platform.

CR-007.title: Company Intelligence Panel enhancements & visibility
CR-007.description: Increase the level of intelligence provided on the Intel panel. Also making it more discoverable and easily accessible than the side panel pop-up.
CR-007.business_justification: Provides validation of the scores and will allow the team to identify any gaps within the scores moving forward.
CR-007.verification: Intelligence is visible without user action. Summary provides quick read.

CR-008.title: Company Intelligence Panel customization
CR-008.description: Customization of MEDDIC Gaps to cover other frameworks e.g., BANT.
CR-008.business_justification: Provides an option for clients to customize based on their existing internal processes.
CR-008.verification: Switching framework constant changes the analysis dimensions displayed.

CR-009.title: Refinement of information on the meeting detail page
CR-009.description: Remove next steps, analysis etc. and provide only important information around scores, score reason, company intelligence, scoring framework and video viewing.
CR-009.business_justification: Removes noise from the meeting analysis and provides the most important information needed for users to make strategic decisions.
CR-009.verification: Meeting detail page is cleaner, key info is immediately visible, noise removed.

CR-001.note: Largest CR, requires n8n changes. Implement last.
